utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts Saturday morning at nine. Bring any spare screws, a flashlight, and gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll bring those. Do you want me to come right at nine, or should I arrive a little early?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my tools by and help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d really help. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll bring the tools by and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive's moving along nicely. Folks are dropping off tools and cash by the hour.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but I hope they’ve got a clear place to sort the tools and cash so nothing gets mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, they’ve set up a table and a few bins right by the hall, so the tools and cash stay separate. Makes it a lot easier for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. What still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The driveway has a cracked patch near the top and the loose gravel still needs to be packed down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can come by and help pack down the gravel after we patch that cracked spot near the top.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, come by the repair drive tonight — I’m inviting a few more neighbors too, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll stop by for a little while. Thanks for inviting me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll see you there. I’ll save you a quick intro to the neighbors when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’ll make sure we cover the spots that need help first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, just point me to the first spot and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo. Start with the west side fence line by the mailbox, and I’ll swing by to show you the next two spots after that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you walk me through what the repair drive needs, and what still has to be checked?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can walk you through it, yeah. We should check the main fixes first, then confirm anything electrical or structural before we call it done.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. Before we mark it done, can you confirm whether the electrical and structural checks are already on the list or still need to be inspected?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school calendar and see which evening still has room.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds good. Let me know what evening you find, and I’ll help make the drive fit around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the calendar tonight and tell you which evening works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m a bit behind on the details. Is there anything I should bring or sign up for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’m just checking what they need to bring and whether there’s a signup list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean you can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, that’s what I meant.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can bring it by, but I forgot which part was acting up. Was it the main latch or the wheel?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it was the main latch, but I can check when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll note you in for it. I’ll check what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up, and I can swing by with supplies if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I could use that. I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, just send me the list and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to ask you about that anyway, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I was just going to bring that up. We’ve got the repair drive coming together, and I can fill you in on the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, fill me in on the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I missed the latest update, but I can still help with it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, then I’ll send you the parts list and timing tonight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, send them when you can and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then let’s keep it simple and get started when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I’m ready when you are. Let’s grab the tools and start with the first step.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive. Let me know what still needs doing, and I’ll take my share.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll send you the list and what’s left this afternoon, and you can grab whichever part fits best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, send it over and I’ll pick the part that fits best.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Let me know what still needs a hand, and I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that. I’ll keep an eye on the map and let you know what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Opal. I’ll keep pointing people your way as the map fills in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the list started and I’m coordinating the first round of repairs this week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the next round too. Tell me what’s still needed and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll send you the list after I confirm the remaining parts and tools. Thanks for keeping an eye on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m only getting that second-hand. Did Mina say what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mina said they still need clean rags, a Phillips screwdriver, and someone to haul the old washer away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, clean rags, a Phillips screwdriver, and help moving the old washer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take a look at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo. I’ll coordinate the timing around the school schedule and let you know when it’s available.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can handle it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m sure I can handle it. I’ll take care of the tricky parts and keep you posted.
